channel.title: Djibouti - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Djibouti, every source cited.

item.title: Balbala town hall extension opens
item.description: Moroccan diplomat and Djiboutian ministers attend inauguration of expanded communal headquarters.

item.title: Djibouti arrests four for online blackmail and child abuse material
item.description: Authorities seized digital content and arrested suspects facing up to 10 years in prison.

item.title: Djibouti president congratulates Turkish counterpart
item.description: President Guelleh expressed a wish for further development and prosperity for the Turkish people.

item.title: Djibouti, Tanzania discuss energy and maritime security
item.description: Djibouti's Prime Minister met with a Tanzanian delegation to explore renewable energy and address Red Sea geopolitical tensions.
